summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a 6-K reporting the approval of a merger of its subsidiary Banco Itaucard S.A. into itself at an extraordinary general meeting on April 28, 2026. The merger involves transfer of all assets and dissolution of Itaucard, with the appraisal report by PricewaterhouseCoopers based on December 31, 2025 book net worth. No purchase price, premium, or consideration was stated as it is an internal consolidation. Board recommended the merger. The move streamlines corporate structure within the group. Watch for regulatory approvals and potential minority appraisal rights actions in Brazil.
